title: OscInt: uniform oscillatory-integral estimates in Lean 4 and Mathlib
description: A Lean 4 + Mathlib library of machine-checked uniform oscillatory-integral estimates in one and two variables: van der Corput's lemma with explicit constants, non-stationary and nondegenerate stationary phase, the uniform fold and D4 (umbilic) estimates with the D4 leading term and its closed-form constant, front ends in Mathlib's idiom with local smoothness and compact families of phases, global decay from a pointwise classification of the phase (also for amplitudes with values in any complex Banach space), and the dispersive estimate t^{-2/3} for the 2D lattice Laplacian with an explicit constant and its sharpness (a classical, separable example). Statements are frozen and timestamped before their proofs and replayed by several independent kernels; statement fidelity is reviewed by AI referees, not yet by a human expert.
keywords: MSC2020: 68V20 Formalization of mathematics in connection with theorem provers
MSC2020: 03B35 Mechanization of proofs and logical operations

The one-dimensional van der Corput proofs are derived from roos-j/lean-oscillatory by J. Roos and M. Praveen (Apache-2.0).
